objective: Reduce measured compilation time/allocation of the general V8 dispatch/terminal-peeling candidate while preserving runtime gains.
method: Inspect saved phase statistics, collect native compiler samples, then choose a source change with a concrete invariant. No benchmark-specific runtime behavior.

protocol.isolation: Serial builds/tests/profiles/benchmarks; read-only analysis may overlap.
protocol.compilation_diagnostics: Six fixed alternating AB/BA pairs after one warmup per binary, unchanged official DataView suite with the same synchronous compiler-statistics flags as the prior experiment.
protocol.runtime_validation: Leading cost candidate: 21 fixed alternating AB/BA pairs on unchanged official DataView suite with stock flags.
protocol.official_compiler_validation: Leading cost candidate: 12 fixed alternating AB/BA pairs on unchanged official Compiler suite; all nine cases reported.
protocol.checkpoints: Unsigned source and result commits for every experiment, including rejected candidates.
protocol.acceptance: Report both cost and runtime changes, native code size, count differences, and confidence intervals. Fewer allocations alone are not evidence of faster compilation.
protocol.remaining_original_cost: After selecting and validating the final candidate, six fixed alternating compilation-diagnostic pairs against the earlier getter-only f090ad58 build measure how much of the original cost remains. These are separate from the fcc-based improvement comparisons.

state: complete: three independent compiler-cost experiments checkpointed; fresh-allocation candidate retained after fixed official validation and post-change profiling

experiments.hypothesis: Use complete field-name and object alias predicate before allocating replacement cache; try cheap name test first. Official Compiler native profile attributes 18.9% of included samples to AbstractField::Kill.
experiments.tests: 81 selected tests pass, including 3 new unit tests.
experiments.screen: Superseded before collecting any official Compiler result: run the already planned12-pair final validation directly. Selected from the fixed six-pair compilation diagnostic; avoids an additional selection-only screen.
experiments.state: six cost pairs, twelve Compiler pairs, and twenty-one stock DataView pairs complete
six cost pairs complete; total time inconclusive
experiments.hypothesis: GraphReducer::Reduce native code has a 0x148-byte stack frame and unconditional ostream vtable setup despite trace_turbo_reduction being false. Move cold trace branches to a noinline helper; keep behavior identical.
experiments.disposition: Retain independently; do not add to leading candidate on code-size evidence alone.

experiments.state: all declared validation and cost comparisons complete; native Compiler and DataView-target post-profiles complete
experiments.hypothesis: Replace linear field-cache scans with exact-key map lookup when the existing Allocate alias rule already restricts aliases to that one node. 89.4% of sampled AbstractField::Kill self time is first-scan dead checks/tree iteration; almost all distinguishable alias-check samples use the Allocate identity path.
experiments.safety: Do not resolve renames before selecting the fast path. Preserve name wildcard behavior, dead-key skip, immutable states and cache counts.
experiments.protocol: Six fixed cost pairs versus fcc; if correctness/native checks pass, twelve fixed official Compiler pairs and twenty-one fixed stock DataView pairs. Previous fixed experiment continues to completion; no early stop on scores.
experiments.disposition: Retain independently on fcc58178: Large-Copy +34.98% over 12 pairs; stock DataView group +0.058% with interval spanning zero. Original DataView compilation overhead remains.

post_validation_diagnostic: After all fixed measurements, a further native profile repeats the unchanged DataView integer target 4000 times, matching the initial target diagnostic, to locate remaining cost. No speedup is inferred from its single capture.
remaining_research: DataView compilation is still +9.62% total time and +11.88% zone allocation versus getter-only; general graph traversal/reduction remains sampled work. Smaller official Compiler estimates are mostly negative but their individual intervals span zero.
